morphology.compounding_rule: Japonic clan-first dithematic ([clan] no [given]; quality/feature + type: Kuro-yama black-mountain, rendaku kawa -> -gawa) layered over Nahuatl place-roots ([quality|feature] + -tepe/-tora/-co): the capital Hino-tepe (sun-mountain-place), Take-no-toriyao (the bamboo war-fort).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Japonic ruling stock keep the clan/house name (uji / -shi) before the given name, -no- linking clan and name (X no Y) and house-suffix -ke; the Nahuatl populace keep the calpolli (ward) name and the calendar-day name, with -tzin reverential for the honored; the throne fuses both - a Shogun-house clan-name over a teocalli lineage.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen shiro (castles) and abandoned teokari (sun-pyramids): 'the ruined Shiro of [clan]', 'the Sunken Teokari of [name]', 'the haunted Jinja of [name]'
patterns.military_units: the [clan] Gun (host) / the [order] knights and the [color] Sonae (battle-formation): 'the Crimson Sonae', 'the Eagle Gun', 'the Jaguar-Samurai of the Sun'
patterns.ships: war-junk and lake war-canoe names: 'the Wave-Cutter', 'the Storm-Crane', 'the Quetzal of the Sun', 'Hagane-maru'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Floating Plum', 'The Obsidian Teahouse', 'The Cacao Court'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Japonic NATIVE-kami canon-morphs PRIMARY (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.japonic; the wholly-native kami, NOT the Sinitic forms), Nahuatl morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.nahuatl), never real kami or Aztec gods (no Amaterasu/Susanoo, no Quetzalcoatl/Huitzilopochtli/Tlaloc). Same shared pantheon, two faces (honji-suijaku: the kami of the shrine-isle and the power of the sun-pyramid are one). Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic: the Lawful keep the ordered way of the blade and the just sun (the kami of sun, steel and ancestors); the Chaotic the blood-fed war-sun and the wild kami (the war-flame, the devouring void, the mountain-oni); the Neutral the ancestral dead (senzo) and the calendar-round, honored at the household shrine and the teocalli.

clergy_ladder.9: Saishu (high priest of the realm) / Hueyi Teopixki (great sacrificer)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as oni (Japonic devils) or tzitzimitl (Nahuatl star-demons), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Takebi-no-kami the War-Flame (Nahuatl Marakatl the Blood-Sun); Vacidus -> Utsuro-no-kami the Devouring Void (Nahuatl Wakitl the Hungering-Dark); Lusanto -> Kogane-Orochi the gold hoard-serpent (Nahuatl Lusankoatl).

holy_symbol_motifs.Hagane-no-kami: a bare blade crossed before a torii
holy_symbol_motifs.Takebi-no-kami: an obsidian knife over a blood-fed war-sun
holy_symbol_motifs.Terashi-no-kami: a rising sun-disc above a mirror and sword, crowning a stepped pyramid

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Jinja (Japonic shrine) within its torii and sacred grove, or the Teokari (Nahuatl pyramid-temple) crowning the sun-pyramid, of [power]: 'the Jinja of Terashi-no-kami', 'the Teokari of Takebi-no-kami'.
religion.saints_pattern: great ancestors and fallen heroes enshrined as kami (the eirei, honored dead) at the clan jinja, and the offered captives and conqueror-tlatoque honored as sun-feeding companions at the teocalli and the skull-rack.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Iwane-no-kami (Nahuatl Gaiantli) - the Rock-Root, the enduring mountain
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Amatsukaze-no-kami (Nahuatl Numenatl) - the Heaven-Wind, sky and wisdom
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Hagane-no-kami (Nahuatl Orlantzin) - the Steel One, the blade-oath and war
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Megumi-hime (Nahuatl Rialtzin) - the Mercy-Maiden, mother and healing
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Terashi-no-kami (Nahuatl Tolratl) - the Shining One, sun and right-rule

religion.the_one: Takami-no-kami (Japonic; Nahuatl Aiternatl) - the High-Heaven One, distant above the myriad kami, honored not petitioned (and, where the realm turns Chaotic, reviled with the Nahuatl substrate as the Tyrant-Sun)

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - chief among them Takebi-no-kami the War-Flame (the Nahuatl Marakatl, the Blood-Sun that must be fed) - and names the Lawful powers, and Takami-no-kami, as the cold tyrant-gods to be defied and starved of blood.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Takami-no-kami, Terashi-no-kami the just sun, Hagane-no-kami of the sworn blade, Megumi-hime the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers oni and tzitzimitl (devils), warded; the warrior-way and the just sun bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the senzo and eirei of the ruling house) and the calendar-round powers of the teocalli and the household shrine; the great powers invoked at the jinja-grove and the pyramid situationally

titles._tiers_note: Japonic clanhold ladder, ascending, ruling over the Nahuatl pyramid-city substrate. Jito (estate-lord) barony; Shugodai (border deputy) march; Shugo (province-governor) county; the Daimyo (great-name war-lord; native Tlatono, a Japonic-Nahuatl fusion of tlatoani 'speaker-king' + -no house-mark) duchy over a Ryogoku; Kokushu (province-master) principality; the Shogun (military overlord; native Hinotaisho, the 'sun-great-general') kingdom over the Bakufu (tent-government); the Tenno (heavenly sovereign) reigns over Tenka (all-under-heaven) as emperor. The conquered cities keep their Nahuatl tlatoani (city-speaker) and teopixqui (god-guardian) beneath the Japonic crown; the kannushi (shrine-priest) and the tlenamacac (fire-offering priest) stand outside the ladder. DISPLAY titles are English except the two approved foreign terms - Daimyo (duchy) and Shogun (kingdom). Rank titles fuse the real Japanese and Nahuatl registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, EXCEPT the two approved commonly-known foreign terms set in 'ruler': Daimyo (duchy) and Shogun (kingdom). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Japonic samurai war-aristocracy over the Nahuatl pyramid-cities of the sun: the Shogun and his Daimyo war-houses at the crown, the Shugo-governors over the teocalli-cities, the samurai retainers sworn to the war-banner; the teopixqui sun-priesthood and the calpolli wards serve beneath)
titles.heir: Yotsugi (the designated heir; the Shogun's chosen son) / Tlatocapiri (the ruling-prince of the substrate-line)
